title: Slow Click Closed II
h1: 8× slow click · closed in · tuned for laptop and S22
vars: The slow click kept between 180 Hz and 1 kHz, small dead room. Nothing the speaker cannot play.
Under 700 Hz, with weight made of harmonics of 55 Hz (165-385 Hz): the ear hears a low note the speaker never plays.
The 8× click with a 16× copy under it, under 800 Hz.
Second slowed click 140 ms later, under 700 Hz, lighter weight.
After-rattle under 600 Hz, and a 100 Hz hum with its harmonics that cuts off at 0.9 s.
12× slow, under 500 Hz, weight from 50 Hz harmonics, tiniest room, hum cutting off. The most closed.
